title.narrative: Support for USAID/Pakistan's Water Management for Enhanced Productivity (WMfEP)

description.narrative: The.WMEP activity's main focus is Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province. The objective is to: develop and share knowledge, experiences and skills; create increased understanding of appropriate water policies; identify water-sector incentives; identify water resources historical uses and current developments. The ultimate.goal of the activity is to increase water and agricultural productivity to trigger sustainable economic growth. Some foreign investments.in the water sector in Pakistan are non-transparent; therefore, the longer-term.costs and benefits to Pakistan are unclear. Furthermore, these investments can benefit certain foreign investors with very little, if any, focus on improving water governance and increasing transparency and accountability in.the water sector investments, while increasing Pakistan's debt. To counter this and promote U.S. private sector opportunities in challenging markets sometimes dominated by such investments, USAID will provide technical assistance to energy sector institutions. This intervention plus private sector collaborations will support the government's transition to clean energy, and make the sector reliable, affordable, and financially sustainable. These interventions will also strengthen governance and management of energy infrastructure which will promote transparency and contribute to energy resilience and independence. Activities will support efforts to decarbonize the energy sector, facilitate access to climate finance and improve the resilience of energy infrastructure to climate change. Activities will engage with government and local businesses, while targeting various levels of the power supply chain -- from generation to transmission to distribution -- and ultimately, the end consumer. This activity advances the Advancing Collective Economic Prosperity and Promoting Energy Resilience and Independenceobjectives.
